selection_decisions.name: go-api-contracts
selection_decisions.reason: The task changes tests only; the established exported API and supported contracts remain unchanged.

selection_decisions.name: go-core-style
selection_decisions.reason: Writing Go tests requires idiomatic naming, formatting, error handling and concurrency ownership.

selection_decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
selection_decisions.reason: No interface, concrete dependency, constructor, options API or production resource lifecycle changes are needed. Test fixture lifetime is covered by go-test-isolation.

selection_decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
selection_decisions.reason: The tests remain in the existing external test package; package responsibilities and import ownership do not change.

selection_decisions.name: go-test-isolation
selection_decisions.reason: The task explicitly involves real files, parent-owned fixtures, grouped parallel children, repeated replacements and focused child selection.
